paragraphs: So it is cited in [the Or Zarua](https://www.sefaria.org/Ohr_Zarua%2C_Volume_II.380.1): [Megillah 21b](https://www.sefaria.org/Megillah.21b.8).[^1]

notes.text: Or Zarua, vol. II, §380, explicitly names Rav Rechumi of Birta deShachorei as the sage who recites the ten-verse rule. In the linked Bavli, Rav Shimi recites the same rule.
